Select the first 1000 IC50 activity rows with non-null pChEMBL values for human single-protein target CHEMBL1795186. Join target_dictionary to assays to activities to molecule_dictionary, then INNER JOIN compound_structures for canonical SMILES. Filter: standard_type = 'IC50', standard_relation = '=', pchembl_value IS NOT NULL, target chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1795186'. Return assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value. Do not deduplicate. Sort by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id. Limit 1000.
